roads.name: Rockledge Drive
words: Curve after curve after curve: 41 in 4.2 miles, about 10 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From -1 to 6 ft, with 49 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 56 buildings a mile beside the road.
11 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 20 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.13 g.
